title.zh: Bitunix分析师：民主党夺回国会制衡美联储人事权，就业韧性仍限制降息空间
title.en: Bitunix分析师：民主党夺回国会制衡美联储人事权，就业韧性仍限制降息空间

current_state.zh: A Bitunix analyst argues that Democrats seizing both chambers of Congress will check the White House's power over Fed appointments, while resilient ADP and JOLTS labor data leave the Fed limited room to cut rates ahead of the November 6 nonfarm payrolls report.
